tools.name: eventbrite_get_me
tools.description: Fetch the Eventbrite user the token belongs to (name, emails). A cheap way to confirm the token works. Eventbrite: GET /users/me/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations you are a member of. Almost every other tool needs an organization_id from here. Eventbrite: GET /users/me/organizations/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_events
tools.description: List the events of an organization, filterable by status, name and past/upcoming. Eventbrite: GET /organizations/{organization_id}/events/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_event
tools.description: Fetch one event: name, summary, start/end, status, capacity, venue_id, listing settings. Use expand=venue,ticket_classes for more. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_event_description
tools.description: Fetch the fully rendered HTML description of an event (summary plus the page modules). Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/description/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_ticket_classes
tools.description: List the ticket types of an event with price, capacity, quantity_sold and sales window. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/ticket_classes/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_venues
tools.description: List the saved venues of an organization, with address and capacity. Eventbrite: GET /organizations/{organization_id}/venues/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_attendees
tools.description: List attendees (one per sold ticket) of one event OR of all of an organization's events. Each attendee carries checked_in, cancelled, refunded, status, ticket_class_name, profile and barcodes (status unused/used). Pass exactly one of event_id / organization_id. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/att

tools.name: eventbrite_get_attendee
tools.description: Fetch one attendee of an event, including check-in state (checked_in, barcodes[].status), answers and cost breakdown. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/attendees/{attendee_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_orders
tools.description: List orders of one event OR of all of an organization's events: buyer name/email, status, costs. Pass exactly one of event_id / organization_id. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/orders/ or GET /organizations/{organization_id}/orders/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_order
tools.description: Fetch one order. Use expand=attendees,event to include its tickets and event. Eventbrite: GET /orders/{order_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_discounts
tools.description: Search an organization's discounts and access codes, with quantity_sold. scope=event needs event_id; multi_events = cross-event discounts; user = all of the organization's. Eventbrite: GET /organizations/{organization_id}/discounts/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_capacity
tools.description: Fetch the event capacity tier: capacity_total, capacity_sold, capacity_pending, quantity_total and capacity holds. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/capacity_tier/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_inventory_tiers
tools.description: List the inventory tiers of a tiered or reserved-seating event, with quantity_total, quantity_sold, quantity_pending and linked ticket_class_ids. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/inventory_tiers/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_sales_report
tools.description: Sales report for one or more events: gross, net, fees, royalty and quantity per time bucket, optionally grouped (by ticket, payment method, country, ...). Eventbrite: GET /reports/sales/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_attendee_report
tools.description: Attendee report for one or more events: number of attendees and orders per time bucket, optionally grouped. Eventbrite: GET /reports/attendees/.

tools.name: eventbrite_create_event
tools.description: Create a new event as a DRAFT (not visible or on sale until eventbrite_publish_event). Add tickets with eventbrite_create_ticket_class before publishing. Eventbrite: POST /organizations/{organization_id}/events/.

tools.name: eventbrite_update_event
tools.description: Change fields of an existing event; only the fields you pass are sent. Changing start/end needs timezone too. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_copy_event
tools.description: Duplicate an event (tickets, payment options, refund policy, tax settings) into a new event with a new ID, optionally with a new name and dates. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/copy/.

tools.name: eventbrite_publish_event
tools.description: Make a draft event live so tickets go on sale. Needs a name, organizer, at least one ticket class and valid payment options. Undo with eventbrite_unpublish_event while there are no orders. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/publish/.

tools.name: eventbrite_unpublish_event
tools.description: Take a published event back to unpublished. Only allowed while it has no pending or completed orders (or, for paid events, once completed and paid out). Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/unpublish/.

tools.name: eventbrite_create_ticket_class
tools.description: Add a ticket type to an event. Paid: set cost like "USD,2500" and capacity. Free: free=true and capacity. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/ticket_classes/.

tools.name: eventbrite_update_ticket_class
tools.description: Change a ticket type (name, price, capacity, sales window, visibility); only the fields you pass are sent. The price cannot change after tickets are sold. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/ticket_classes/{ticket_class_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_create_venue
tools.description: Save a new venue under an organization, to use as an event's venue_id. Eventbrite: POST /organizations/{organization_id}/venues/.

tools.name: eventbrite_create_discount
tools.description: Create a promo code (type=coded), a public discount (type=public, single event) or an access code that unlocks hidden tickets (type=access). Scope: event_id (+ticket_class_ids) for one event, ticket_group_id for a group, neither for all the organization's events. Eventbrite: POST /organizations/{org

tools.name: eventbrite_update_discount
tools.description: Change a discount or access code (amount, uses, dates, scope); only the fields you pass are sent. Eventbrite: POST /discounts/{discount_id}/.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "eventbrite_list_discounts" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: organization_id, scope, event_id, code, code_filter, type, page_size, continuation

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: eventbrite_get_me, eventbrite_get_event_description, eventbrite_list_ticket_classes, eventbrite_list_attendees, eventbrite_list_orders, eventbrite_get_order, eventbrite_get_sales_report · Private data: eventbrite_get_me · Public sink: eventbrite_list_orders, eventbrite_create_event, eventbrite_update_event, eventbrite_copy_event, eventbrite_publish_event, eventbrite_unpublish_event, eventbrite_create_ticket_class, eventbrite_update_ticket_class, eventbrite_create_venue, eventbrite_create_discount, eventbrite_update_discount.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: eventbrite_get_me, eventbrite_get_event_description, eventbrite_list_ticket_classes, eventbrite_list_attendees, eventbrite_list_orders, eventbrite_get_order, eventbrite_get_sales_report · Private data: eventbrite_get_me · Public sink: eventbrite_list_orders, eventbrite_create_event, eventbrite_update_event, eventbrite_copy_event, eventbrite_publish_event, eventbrite_unpublish_event, eventbrite_create_ticket_class, eventbrite_update_ticket_class, eventbrite_create_venue, eventbrite_create_discount, eventbrite_update_discount

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
